Technical SEO.title: Google Confirms Deploying goto URL Redirects to Search Results Links
Technical SEO.summary: Google has confirmed it is rolling out google.com/goto passthrough URLs within search results, a change that began testing in mid-2026. The move appears designed to prevent third-party tools and AI companies from scraping search results.

Technical SEO.title: Confirmed: Google Search Rolling Out google.com/goto Tracking Parameters
Technical SEO.summary: Google Search is rolling out the google.com/goto URL as a passthrough redirect within search results, a format it began testing previously. Google has not yet officially commented on the purpose of this goto URL parameter, though it is believed to help prevent scraping by third-party and AI tools.

Technical SEO.title: Analysis: Reddit Appears in 83.9% of Google Discussions and Forums Results
Technical SEO.summary: An Ahrefs data analysis found Reddit.com appears in 83.9% of Google Discussions and Forums results worldwide, with an average of 1.29 link appearances per SERP. The study examined how prominent individual domains are within this SERP feature.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: We Analyzed 107 Million AI Answers. Here is Where Each Industry Citation Actually Comes From
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A large-scale analysis of 107 million AI answers identifies the top citation sources by industry across major AI platforms. The findings have direct implications for brands seeking visibility in AI-generated responses.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Tools Recommend Brands But Cite Other Sites, Data Shows
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A new report reveals that AI tools frequently recommend specific brands in their answers while citing third-party websites rather than the brand's own site as the source. This citation gap has significant implications for enterprise GEO strategy.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Judge Says Google and Publisher AI Situation Seems Really Unfair
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The judge who previously ruled Google is a monopoly commented during the Penske vs. Google hearing that the AI Overviews situation appears unfair to publishers. The case is relevant to enterprise publishers navigating organic traffic loss from AI-generated answers.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How to Keep a Crisis from Defining Your Brand Online
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece examines how a reputation crisis can shape how a brand appears in both search and AI results for years, raising the stakes for enterprise brands managing long-term search and GEO visibility. It addresses the intersection of reputation management and AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Searches Individual Subreddits By Name
AI Search / GEO.summary: ChatGPT is now able to search individual subreddits by name, and Reddit continues to win citations in ChatGPT when a forum is deemed the best source. Two data captures taken four days apart illustrate what factors determine citation credit.

AI Search / GEO.title: Reddit ChatGPT Search Citations Fell 86% in Four Days: Report
AI Search / GEO.summary: A report found that Reddit citations in ChatGPT Search dropped by 86% over a four-day period, signaling significant volatility in how AI search surfaces forum content. This has direct implications for GEO strategies that rely on Reddit for AI citation share.

AI Search / GEO.title: Bing Tests Renaming Copilot Search Answer To AI Overviews
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft is testing renaming the Copilot Search AI answer box in Bing results to AI Overviews, adopting the same terminology Google uses for its AI answer feature. The Copilot logo is retained alongside the renamed label in the test.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI Pins Shopping To ChatGPT Sidebar
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI has added a persistent Shopping tab to the left sidebar of ChatGPT, linking to a dedicated shopping search experience. This structural change increases the prominence of commercial queries within ChatGPT and is relevant to e-commerce and travel SEO strategies.
